result:
I ran every query below against its data file and checked the answers by eye. I also checked Z13 by hand: 125 + 0 + 269.97 + 52.5 + 28 = 475.47. I haven't confirmed that `sum` of an empty list answers 0, which Z3 and Z5 depend on for orders with empty items.

Z1: get /users | filter ~(allOf (get /active | eq true) ~(query /address/city | ne null)) | map ~(get /address/city | lower) | toSet | sort
Z2: get /users | filter ~(allOf (get /active | eq true) ~(get /age | ne null)) | map /age | avg | mul 10 | round | div 10
Z3: filter ~(get /status | lower | eq "paid") | map ~(query /items [] | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
Z4: filter ~(get /status | lower | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(get /customer | lower) | map ~(count)
Z5: filter ~(get /status | lower | ne "cancelled") | groupBy ~(get /customer | lower) | map ~(map ~(query /items [] | map ~(mulOf /qty /price) | sum) | sum) | entries | sort ~(get [~(get /1 | desc) /0]) | take 3 | map ~(get /0 | toString)
Z6: filter ~(allOf (get /state | eq "open") ~(get /assignee | eq null) ~(get /labels | map ~(lower) | contains "bug")) | count
Z7: filter ~(get /state | eq "open") | sort ~(get [~(get /comments | desc) /number]) | take 3 | map ~(get {:number /number :title /title})
Z8: groupBy ~(query /assignee/login "unassigned") | map ~(count)
Z9: get [/dependencies /devDependencies] | map ~(entries) | reduce [] ~(concat) | filter ~(get /1 | startsWith "^") | map ~(get /0 | toString | lower) | sort | join ","
Z10: get /services | filter ~(get /enabled | eq true) | map ~(query /replicas null | if (eq null) ~(1) ~(it)) | sum
Z11: lines | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " " | get /3 | take 1) | apply ~(get {:"2xx" ~(filter ~(eq "2") | count) :"4xx" ~(filter ~(eq "4") | count) :"5xx" ~(filter ~(eq "5") | count)})
Z12: lines | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split " " | get [/1 /4]) | filter ~(get /0 | eq "GET") | map ~(get /1 | trim | split "ms" | get /0 | toNumber) | avg | mul 10 | round | div 10
Z13: lines | drop 1 | filter ~(ne "") | map ~(split ",") | filter ~(get /2 | lower | eq "tools") | map ~(get [~(get /3 | if (eq "") ~("0") ~(it) | toNumber) ~(get /4 | toNumber)] | apply ~(mulOf /0 /1)) | sum | mul 100 | round | div 100
Z14: "alice@Example.com, bob@example.org; carol@EXAMPLE.COM, dave@mail.test, erin@Example.org, frank@mail.test" | split #"[,;]\s*" | map ~(split "@" | get /1 | lower) | toSet | sort
